notice: All organizations, inputs, activity and results are synthetic. This proposed workflow is not a connected employer system or measured company performance.
title: Start with a proposal the team can inspect.
intro: A proposed agent-operations workbench for Genspark: connect product-qualified signals to a versioned definition, an evidence snapshot and an accountable human reviewer.
queueIntro: Product activity only becomes a qualified signal after account identity and metric definitions are agreed. A personal workspace, a test account and a business account are different cases.
workbenchIntro: Inspect a proposed CRM handoff before any write. This local demo never changes a CRM, ad account or email system and grants no automatic-action permission.
firstBuild: A PQL proposal with its evidence attached
firstBody: Join a verified business account to meaningful product activity, preserve current ownership and log the definition version, proposed action and review outcome.

fields.label: Business account distinguished from personal or test use
PQL definition version approved by stakeholders
Billing context reconciled with the account
Existing CRM owner and opportunity checked
Evidence snapshot and decision key recorded

rules.title: Resolve the workspace context
rules.next: Do not treat a personal or internal test workspace as a business buying signal.

rules.title: Agree on the PQL definition
rules.next: A metric needs a shared definition before it becomes an automated qualification rule.

rules.title: Look for meaningful product value
rules.next: Raw visits alone do not establish a product-qualified account. Confirm the agreed milestone.

rules.title: Reconcile billing context
rules.next: Match plan and account identity before interpreting a product signal or preparing an expansion action.

rules.title: Preserve current ownership
rules.next: Check active opportunities and account ownership before proposing another handoff.

rules.title: Record the decision evidence
rules.next: Attach the input snapshot, definition version and stable key so a reviewer can reconstruct the proposal.

rules.title: Name the human approver
rules.next: Propose mode needs an accountable reviewer. Acceptance history alone is not permission for an automatic write.

ready.title: Ready for a human-reviewed proposal
ready.next: The reviewer can inspect the evidence and proposed handoff. Any later automation policy would require separate scope, evaluation and approval.

experiments.name: Evidence attached to PQL proposals
experiments.hypothesis: Reviewers can distinguish real usage signals from noisy activity.
experiments.guardrail: False positives and missed existing ownership
experiments.allocation: Use matched account cohorts and a fixed observation window. Review uncertainty and selection effects before expansion.

experiments.name: Narrow agent before broad automation
experiments.hypothesis: One accountable motion is easier to evaluate and maintain.
experiments.treatment: PQL proposals with one owner and metric
experiments.primary: Useful proposals per unit of operating cost
experiments.allocation: Use matched account cohorts and a fixed observation window. Review uncertainty and selection effects before expansion.

roadmap.title: Agree on the data definitions
roadmap.body: Map CRM, product and billing entities. Define PQL, qualification and attribution before writing automation.
roadmap.measure: Join quality and agreed metric definitions

roadmap.title: Ship in propose mode
roadmap.body: Build one narrow workflow with a human reviewer, decision snapshots and explicit failure handling.
roadmap.measure: Acceptance, corrections and cost per useful outcome

roadmap.title: Turn evidence into a reference workflow
roadmap.body: Evaluate the pilot with the GTM Engineering lead. Document architecture, limitations and the conditions for any policy change.
roadmap.measure: Repeat use, error recovery and reproducible demo quality

metricsTitle: One motion, one review trail, one cost denominator.
metricsIntro: Illustrative agent evaluations. Acceptance is useful feedback, not blanket authority to make external changes.
metricsNotes: Costs are invented examples, not Genspark prices or a complete model of labor and infrastructure.
Track returned proposals by error class, not only the aggregate acceptance rate.
Every external action needs the appropriate policy and owner; this portfolio only records local review receipts.
